text:
Maya CS: Heads-up — PulseWave's recommender team just flipped on a new batch pipeline, embedding volume up ~6x this morning. Seen a latency bump on their hosted endpoints. :eyes:
Ben CSE: seeing logs too, matched a spike starting 09:12 PST. They switched to a longer context (6k -> 12k) for rerank. Might need more KV cache or a different model variant.
Maya CS: onboarding status: they still haven't completed the advanced enablement session (week-of 3/15). I'm worried for renewal if performance regresses. They did ask about dedicated capacity earlier.
Carla AM: renewal is Jul 15 — flagged this as an upsell opportunity but also a risk if we don't stabilize before Q2 planning. Can we get a quick triage and then propose a dedicated pod cost estimate?
Ben CSE: agree. Quick checklist: - confirm model variant and seq length - enable prefix KV caching - suggest quantized variant for throughput
Tom SRE: I can spin a temporary dedicated pod for testing. ETA ~2h if approved.
Maya CS: can we get a preliminary cost ballpark? I'll loop in procurement.
Ben CSE: estimate for a 4x capacity pod: ~$5.2k/mo (rough) — I can firm up with exact GPU profile.
Carla AM: also capture feedback: they reported inconsistent trace IDs in Console; that was filed to eng-runtime last week.
Maya CS: booking enablement workshop for next Tue 10:00 PT — invite going out to PulseWave eng leads. Need someone from runtime to demo cache settings.
Ben CSE: I can demo. Recommend a gradual rollout policy — start 10% traffic on dedicated pod with fallback to hosted.
scaling-bot: autoscaler triggered: pulsewave-prod endpoints CPU > 85% for 6m. Actions: notified oncall. <https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/REDACTED>
Tom SRE: Oncall noticed an OOM on one shard, rerouted traffic — full logs in #eng-runtime if you need them.
Maya CS: noted. Carla — want me to prep a renewal playbook with runbook steps and SLA comparisons for the dedicated option?
Carla AM: yes please. Include a 'what to expect' section: cost, latency gain, migration window, rollback plan.
Ben CSE: I'll prepare a short perf runbook and a snippet to toggle caching:
```
POST /v1/configs/cache
{ "customer": "pulsewave", "kv_cache": true, "prefix_ttl": 3600 }
```
Maya CS: great. Single pain-point to capture for product: they reported 'occasional 200-500ms tail latency spikes during heavy rerank loads'.
Carla AM: adding to feedback doc and tagging PMs.
Maya CS: Action items:
- Ben: perf runbook + firmed cost quote (due EOD)
- Tom: temp pod spin & collect logs (in progress)
- Ben: prepare demo for Tue workshop
- Carla: draft renewal playbook + slide for execs
I'll update PulseWave after Ben's EOD update. :thumbsup:
Ben CSE: on it.
Tom SRE: temp pod provisioned. IP: 10.12.8.99 — running synthetic rerank load now.
Maya CS: thanks team. I'll notify PulseWave and include these tracks in the renewal notes.
